name: Forward-Back Rope Jump
setup: Rope behind the heels, handles at the hips, elbows close to the sides.
cues: Jump the rope forward and back over a line on the floor, light and quick.
Small, quiet contacts on the floor, an inch high.
Turn the rope with the wrists, the handles at the hips.

faults.fault: Jumping too high over the rope
faults.fix: Clear the rope by an inch: small, quiet contacts on the floor.

faults.fault: Big arm circles
faults.fix: Keep the handles at the hips and turn the rope with small circles.
